method: Per-scene NDVI, temporal median, scene-wide cloud <30%, SCL classes 4/5/6 retained, at least two valid observations per period, common mask, regional means at 10 m EPSG:32643
status: Pilot executed in Earth Engine Code Editor; not connected to dashboard; script backup saved locally; editor script not saved to a cloud repository
limitations: NDVI change is not a validated land-cover conversion measurement. Crops, weather, phenology and residual cloud may affect it. SCL mask is a baseline. Coverage is a raster area estimate.
